dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.
Includes indexes.
Leather binding.
V. 1: [2] pages, [1] leaf, [507] pages, [1] leaf of plates, [2] double leaves of plates -- v. 2: [2], 443 pages, [1] leaf of plates, [5] double leaves of plates.
First 2 and last 2 pages blank, v. 1; and first 2 and last 2 pages blank, v. 2 (included in page description).
Engraved, hand colored title pages (v. 1 & 2).
Introductory text, including charts and diagrams (v. 1).
Descriptive text on versos of maps, as well as in cartouches on some maps.
Decorative cartouches, latitudinal and longitudinal lines, rhumb lines, inset maps, indexes, coats of arms.
Maps show political boundaries, topography, vegetation, waterways, shoals.
Map 1 shows world.
Numerous maps include imprints crediting Willem Janszoon and Joan Blaeu, e.g. Amsterdami apud Guiljelmum et Joannem Blaeuw (indicated in contents notes by ellipses).
Partial list of contributors presented in order of appearance.
